options.name: ca_cert
options.description: Required certificate issuer.

options.name: description
options.description: Description of the host in Zabbix.

options.name: force
options.description: Overwrite the host configuration, even if already present.

options.name: host_groups
options.description: List of host groups the host is part of. Make sure the Zabbix user used for Ansible can read these groups.

options.name: host_name
options.description: Name of the host in Zabbix. I(host_name) is the unique identifier used and cannot be updated using this module.

options.name: http_login_password
options.description: Basic Auth password

options.name: http_login_user
options.description: Basic Auth login

options.name: interfaces
options.description: List of interfaces to be created for the host (see example below). For more information, review host interface documentation at U(https://www.zabbix.com/documentation/current/en/manual/api/reference/hostinterface/object#host-interface)

options.name: inventory_mode
options.description: Configure the inventory mode.

options.name: inventory_zabbix
options.description: Add Facts for a zabbix inventory (e.g. Tag) (see example below). Please review the interface documentation for more information on the supported properties U(https://www.zabbix.com/documentation/current/en/manual/api/reference/host/object#host-inventory)

options.name: ipmi_authtype
options.description: IPMI authentication algorithm. Please review the Host object documentation for more information on the supported properties https://www.zabbix.com/documentation/3.4/manual/api/reference/host/object Possible values are, C(0) (none), C(1) (MD2), C(2) (MD5), C(4) (straight), C(5) (OEM), C(6) (RMCP+), with -1 being the API default. Please note that the Zabbix API will treat absent settings as default when updating any of the I(ipmi_)-options; this means that if you attempt to set any of the four opt

options.name: ipmi_password
options.description: IPMI password. also see the last note in the I(ipmi_authtype) documentation

options.name: ipmi_privilege
options.description: IPMI privilege level. Please review the Host object documentation for more information on the supported properties https://www.zabbix.com/documentation/3.4/manual/api/reference/host/object Possible values are C(1) (callback), C(2) (user), C(3) (operator), C(4) (admin), C(5) (OEM), with C(2) being the API default. also see the last note in the I(ipmi_authtype) documentation

options.name: ipmi_username
options.description: IPMI username. also see the last note in the I(ipmi_authtype) documentation

options.name: link_templates
options.description: List of templates linked to the host.

options.name: macros
options.description: List of user macros to assign to the zabbix host. Providing I(macros=[]) with I(force=yes) will clean all of the existing user macros from the host.

options.name: monitored_by
options.description: Parameter introduced in Zabbix 7.0. Source that is used to monitor the host.

options.name: proxy
options.description: The name of the Zabbix proxy to be used. Required if C(monitored_by) is "proxy"

options.name: proxy_group
options.description: Parameter introduced in Zabbix 7.0. Proxy group that is used to monitor the host. Required if C(monitored_by) is "proxy_group"

options.name: state
options.description: State of the host. On C(present), it will create if host does not exist or update the host if the associated data is different. On C(absent) will remove a host if it exists.

options.name: status
options.description: Monitoring status of the host.

options.name: tags
options.description: List of host tags to assign to the zabbix host. Providing I(tags=[]) with I(force=yes) will clean all of the tags from the host.

options.name: tls_accept
options.description: Specifies what types of connections are allowed for incoming connections. The tls_accept parameter accepts values of 1 to 7 Possible values, 1 (no encryption), 2 (PSK), 4 (certificate). Values can be combined.

options.name: tls_connect
options.description: Specifies what encryption to use for outgoing connections. Possible values, 1 (no encryption), 2 (PSK), 4 (certificate).

options.name: tls_psk
options.description: PSK value is a hard to guess string of hexadecimal digits. The preshared key, at least 32 hex digits. Required if either I(tls_connect) or I(tls_accept) has PSK enabled. Using this parameter makes this module non-idempotent.

options.name: tls_psk_identity
options.description: It is a unique name by which this specific PSK is referred to by Zabbix components Do not put sensitive information in the PSK identity string, it is transmitted over the network unencrypted. Works only with >= Zabbix 3.0 Using this parameter with Zabbix >= 5.4 makes this module non-idempotent.

options.name: tls_subject
options.description: Required certificate subject.

options.name: visible_name
options.description: Visible name of the host in Zabbix.
